All 27 verify.commands were executed against main at commit 4980392 on 2026-08-31 before shipping the contract. Ten invariant-preserving commands PASS today (they fire only on a regression) and fourteen feature-detecting commands FAIL today (they genuinely detect the new work); three are cargo.
